name: execution_runtime_health
description: Execute Java, Go, Python, Ruby, Node, npm, and npx probes and the canonical Summary-only PR-description policy on the broad execution worker.

data.description: This task ignores task.input_data entirely; it always self-probes the current process's runtime environment.

healthy.description: Final health verdict: runtimeHealthy AND the PR-description policy is healthy.

runtimeHealthy.description: True when every required runtime family is available in both inherited and isolated environments, idle-sleep inhibition is active, and worker guards are healthy.

optionalFamilies.description: Runtime family names reported but excluded from the healthy verdict (dotnet, php, elixir).

families.description: Map of runtime family name (java, go, python, ruby, typescript, dotnet, php, elixir) to its availability report.

requiredTools.description: CLI tools that must be available for this family.

inheritedAvailable.description: True if all required tools are available in the inherited (non-isolated) environment.

isolatedAvailable.description: True if all required tools are available in the isolated environment.

available.description: True when available in both environments.

required.description: False for optional families (dotnet, php, elixir), which do not affect the healthy verdict.

executionDeadlinePolicy.description: Fixed policy label describing how long execution tasks run for.

leaseRenewalEnabled.description: True when CONDUCTOR_WORKER_ALL_LEASE_EXTEND_ENABLED is set to a truthy value in the environment.

idleSleepInhibitionActive.description: True when this process holds an active idle-sleep-inhibition assertion.

idleSleepInhibitionMechanism.description: Mechanism used to inhibit idle sleep (`caffeinate -i` on macOS, otherwise `not-required`).

typescriptCompilerPolicy.description: Fixed policy label describing how the TypeScript compiler is invoked.

inheritedCapabilities.description: Per-tool probe result in the inherited (non-isolated) environment, keyed by tool name.

isolatedCapabilities.description: Per-tool probe result in the isolated environment, keyed by tool name.

workerGuards.description: Inventory of lease-renewal/idle-sleep-inhibition guards installed on every worker registered in this process.

healthy.description: True when at least one worker is registered and every registered worker is guarded.

registeredWorkers.description: Number of workers registered in this process.

guardedWorkers.description: Number of registered workers with both lease renewal and idle-sleep inhibition enabled.

task.description: Task definition name the worker handles.

domain.description: Conductor task domain, or empty string if unset.

leaseRenewal.description: True if lease-extend is enabled for this worker.

idleSleepInhibition.description: True if this worker's function is marked idle-sleep-inhibited.

threadCount.description: Configured concurrent thread count for this worker.

guarded.description: True when both leaseRenewal and idleSleepInhibition are true.

prDescriptionPolicy.description: Result of exercising the canonical Summary-only PR-description policy against hostile prose and a template-backed issue body.

healthy.description: True when both the provided-body and issue-template-fallback samples satisfy the policy.

requiredHeading.description: The fixed heading every PR body must start with.

maxSummaryChars.description: Maximum allowed length of the summary text.

providedSample.description: Formatted result for a summary supplied directly.

templateSample.description: Formatted result for a summary derived from the repo's issue template.

workerRole.description: Fixed label identifying this as the broad execution worker pool.

modules.description: Worker modules this health check covers; always ["openspecops"] for this task.
